resources.string:
Hi, my name is Gerfel.

I love getting new experiences and discovering new alternates through stories and fiction.

I've read hundreds of thousands of pages — mostly Japanese manga — and every story teaches me something new.

I also feel joy connecting with people who share the same interests.
That's why I often leave comments here and there, just to share thoughts and start conversations.

It always makes me happy when I see comments from others on works I recently enjoyed.
It feels great to know that there are people out there who feel the same excitement about a story as I do.

Hi, my name is Jerome Lloyd Langcao.

I love playing billiards and video games — it's my way to relax and have fun.

I also enjoy watching movies and having a cup of coffee, especially during my pressure days — it's my comfort zone.
Those moments help me recharge and find peace whenever things get stressful.

I like socializing and meeting new people, but it still depends on their attitude and vibe.
I enjoy being around people who are respectful, positive, and fun to talk to.

In this generation, it's nice to connect with others who share the same energy and interests — it makes everything more enjoyable.

Hi, my name is Ivan Risan Llenares.

I've always been fascinated by technology — the kind that brings ideas to life through code and creativity.

I love exploring new things, whether it's developing apps, learning about systems, or experimenting with small projects that make everyday life easier.

When I'm not coding, I enjoy listening to music, relaxing with friends, or just thinking about what to build next.

Fun fact: I can spend hours solving bugs, but the moment I fix one, it feels like winning a mini battle.

Maybe someday I'll create something that helps others as much as tech has helped me.

Until then, I'll keep learning, building, and having fun along the way.

Hi, my name is Kent.

I'm someone who loves experiencing life through different adventures and forms of expression.

I enjoy exploring new places and traveling because it lets me discover new cultures, people, and ideas.
I also love playing video games — not just for fun, but because they allow me to experience stories, challenges, and worlds beyond reality.

Music is another big part of my life; it helps me relax, express my emotions, and stay inspired.
And of course, I love watching movies, whether it's for the excitement, the storytelling, or just the simple comfort of relaxing after a long day.

Altogether, these interests shape who I am: curious, creative, and always open to new experiences.

Hi, my name is Kent Andrei L. Uyguangco.

I'm a 21-year-old XU student raised in Iligan City.

My main passion is collecting and customizing Gunpla Model Kits. I love to paint them and build detailed dioramas.

I also enjoy a variety of creative and practical skills, including Painting, Drawing, Sculpting, Cooking, and Cleaning.

When it comes to food, I really like fish, especially served in a hot soup or simply fried.
